_comment: Manifest for the three GT06 battery datasets (tracking / idle / sleep). Top-level keys (unplug_epoch, power_w, track_current_ma, bin_seconds) describe the TRACKING dataset and are read by the SoC/R fit scripts; per-dataset detail is under 'datasets'. See METHOD.md.

tracking.source: event-8 daily position logs 2026_06_18..21.jsonl.gz (bat_v, 60 s median bins)
tracking.note: bat_v = per-bin median terminal V (10 mV grid); chg=1 if any sample in the bin charged. SoC is reconstructed by the fitter (constant-power charge integration). Units reaching cutoff are the firm anchors.

idle.mode: parked race-idle (~6 mA, GPS off, 30-min uploads)
idle.source: GT06 binary packet log (cxzt# *BT 1 mV + STATUS# Battery 10 mV)
idle.note: Low-noise idle voltage trajectory (~1 mV/h). idle_voltages.csv is the per-unit median summary derived from this, used as the R-fit low-load anchor.

sleep.mode: MODE5 overnight deep-sleep (hourly wakes) bracketed by idle endpoints
sleep.phases: pre_idle (parked, before 02:00) | sleep_wake (hourly MODE5 wake reads, noisy) | post_idle (settled race-idle after ~08:00 wake)
sleep.note: The sleep-power estimate uses the two low-noise idle endpoints (last pre_idle, first settled post_idle); the sleep_wake reads are noisy (load transient at each wake) and kept only as evidence/validation.
